question: Explain how the second period starts with lithium.

options.text: When the second electron enters the 2p orbital
When the third electron enters the 2p orbital
When the second electron enters the 2s orbital
When the third electron enters the 2s orbital

solution:
The correct answer is **When the third electron enters the 2s orbital.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lithium**

 
 
• **​**Lithium is the **first chemical element **in the periodic table's alkalis with **atomic number 3.**
 
• **The electronic configuration of Li is **1s²2s¹
 
• the last electron enters in 2S orbital 
 
• The last electron enters in 2nd shell of 2s orbital.
 
• It is present in the **Earth's crust at a 65 ppm** (parts per million) level, making it **moderately abundant.**
 
• It is the metal with the **lowest density** and the solid element with the lowest density under typical conditions.
 
• Several of the metal's alloys and compounds, as well as the** soft, white, and lustrous **metal itself, are manufactured on an industrial scale.
 
• Lithium is the **only** alkali metal that the **anion Li **does not form in solution or in the solid state 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Element group**

 
 
• On the periodic table, an element group is a **vertical column**. There are the **same number** of valence electrons in each group of atoms.
 
• There are **18 groups** of elements.** Chemical and physical **properties are shared by elements in the **same group**.
 
 
 
• **Element period**
 
 
• On the periodic table, an element period is a **horizontal row**. There are the** same number **of electron shells in each period atom.
 
• The **highest level of unexcited electron** energy and the number of electron shells that each element has share the same period.
 
• There are **seven periods** of elements. Because the number of electrons allowed in an energy sublevel determines the number of elements included, some periods contain more elements than others.
